errors.evidence: The machine description states that the unit of the x-axis is 'order of magnitude' (数量级), which is incorrect. The x-axis represents 'Data Volume' (数据量) with a linear scale of counts (0, 5000, 10000...), not orders of magnitude (like 10^1, 10^2).
The description claims that data points are marked with circles, but the line plot in the figure does not have any visible markers (like circles) at the data points.

The description identifies the score of 31.55 at data volume 10000 as 'the peak' (的峰值). This is an over-generalization, as it is only a local peak. The overall maximum score shown in the plot is 33.43 at data volume 40000.
